source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 26 to 30
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 23, 2026 · 18 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! The Séance of Blake Manor Raw Fury ☆☆☆☆☆ 94 ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass The Séance of Blake Manor – October 27Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere It is October 28th, 1897, and Private Investigator Declan Ward arrives at Blake Manor to find a missing woman. What he finds is the Grand Séance and a group of mystics who have gathered from all corners of the world – waiting for All Hallow’s Eve, the night when the veil between worlds is thinnest. The night to tear down the barrier and speak to the dead. Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions. Uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought everyone together. Mouthwashing CRITICAL REFLEX ☆☆☆☆☆ 392 ★★★★★ $12.99 $10.39 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Mouthwashing – October 29XBOX Play Anywhere Mouthwashing is a first-person horror game following the dying crew of a shipwrecked space freighter. Who could have known what good ol’ Captain Curly was capable of? Guess he thought his crew dying alongside him was only right. But some men can’t even kill themselves properly. Maimed, limbless and unable to speak, but alive, Curly is now at the mercy of the crew he has doomed to a slow death. The Wolf Among Us Remastered Telltale ☆☆☆☆☆ 100 ★★★★★ $24.99 $19.99 Get it now The Wolf Among Us Remastered – October 29 Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning. Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered – the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before – honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players. Queen's Domain Future Friends Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 59 ★★★★★ $19.99 $16.99 Get it now Queen’s Domain – October 30 Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) Funktronic Labs ☆☆☆☆☆ 159 ★★★★★ $12.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) – October 26Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Scramble Knights Online, an MMO-lite adventure! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracott! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training. Terrible Lizards Digital Pajamas ☆☆☆☆☆ 624 ★★★★★ $24.99 $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Terrible Lizards – October 29Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Something is very wrong at Dalton’s Dinos, the once must-see Route 66 roadside attraction baking under the New Mexico sun. The staff have vanished, but a mysterious voice on the telephone you find in the attraction begs you for help to find a missing child. You’d leave… if your car hadn’t died miles from anywhere. It’s 1992. No cell phones. No rideshares. No help coming, and you’ll soon find that you are not alone inside the attraction. Ayasa: Shadows of Silence Aya Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 5 ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now Ayasa: Shadows of Silence – October 26 Step into the eerie world of Ayasa, a dark tale that blends quests, horror, and puzzles into a haunting journey. Without a single spoken word, the story is told through pantomime, surreal imagery, and a soundtrack composed by Komitas. You will navigate six symbolic lands Faith, Hope, Love, Greed, Indifference, and Betrayal—each corrupted by darkness. Every choice you make, every act of compassion or indifference, may lead to an unexpected ending. Will you restore balance or become the very force you sought to defeat? PAO PAO (Game Preview) Dreland Enterprises ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Free Trial PAO PAO – October 26 Explore a lively town where every day brings something new. Meet quirky characters, discover cozy little spots and landmarks, gather resources in the wild, or simply wander around and see what’s happening. With changing weather, seasons and a full day-night cycle, PAO PAO is always a little different. Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services Destroyer Doggo ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services – October 27XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services, where things don’t need to be perfect — just a little cleaner, a little calmer, and a little more you. Whether you’re curled up with a podcast or just need something peaceful to help the world feel quieter, this gentle 2D pressure washing game is here for you. No timers, no stress, just pastel pixel art, soft sounds, and the satisfying swish of clean water. Bloom Busters UBrothers ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Bloom Busters – October 27Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Bloomland is under attack. A toxic infestation has twisted its gardens and filled them with cheeky mutated creatures – and Jimmy and Jessie are ready to clean up the mess. source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 19 to 23
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 16, 2026 · 9 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Activision Publishing Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 514 ★★★★★ Get it now Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – October 23XBOX Play Anywhere Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point. Pre-order Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 today to gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 ahead of its global launch on October 23. FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ Get it now Final Fantasy Resonance – October 22XBOX Play Anywhere What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive. A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more. Shoresy: Legends of the North New Metric Media ☆☆☆☆☆ 10 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Shoresy: Legends of the North – October 19 Shoresy: Legends of the North is a fast-paced hockey RPG set in the Shoresy universe. Create your skater and join the Sudbury Blueberry Bulldogs on a quest to save the world from the legendary Hockey Godz, or go head-to-head with friends with a roster of fan-favourite characters. Candlemates (Xbox Series) Afil Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $4.99 Get it now Candlemates – October 20 Get ready for a bright adventure full of strategy in Candlemates! Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference! Christmas Across America Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $6.99 Get it now Christmas Across America Collector’s Edition – October 20 Immerse yourself in the holiday spirit! Journey into the heart of winter America to create traditions, find hidden treasures, and experience the magic of the coziest time of year. Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $9.99 Get it now Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector’s Edition – October 20 Feel the sea breeze and the endless horizon! This is the beginning of a grand journey. For the first time, you step aboard a luxurious liner to spend an unforgettable honeymoon! In Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey, warm encounters and cozy evenings await, as your route takes you through the colorful islands of the Pacific Ocean. This isn’t just a sightseeing tour, it’s a celebration of life, where every day brings new emotions. ESG Football 27 Elite Sports Gaming LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ 76 ★★★★★ Get it now Elite Sports Gaming Football – October 20 ESG Football 27 is bigger, faster, and more connected than ever. Build your player, compete with friends, and experience football your way with brand-new 11v11 Rec Mode, cross-play between PlayStation and Xbox, improved matchmaking and connectivity, tutorials to learn the fundamentals, nostalgia-inspired mini-games, and a deeper player progression system with grindable badges and boosts to increase your character’s attributes. Whether you’re playing Head-to-Head, teaming up in 11v11, or grinding to build your player, ESG Football 27 brings the ultimate football experience to life. Family Journey: Hidden Across The World Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $6.99 Get it now Family Journey: Hidden Across The World Collector’s Edition – October 20 Pack your bags and join a loving family on a heartwarming journey around the world! Sharpen your eye for detail across 60 beautifully crafted hidden object scenes, each inspired by real-world cities and iconic landmarks. Take a break from searching with 12 delightful mini games and brain teasing puzzles that the whole family can enjoy together. This Collector’s Edition is packed with exclusive extras, enjoy bonus levels, a music player and achievements to keep the adventure alive. Personalize your experience in a special interior scene where you can buy furniture, and test your skills to unlock 10 unique achievements. Hail to the Rainbow Sometimes You ☆☆☆☆☆ 37 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Free Trial Hail to the Rainbow – October 20Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Hail to the Rainbow is a first-person, story-driven adventure with horror and shooter elements. Set in a richly detailed world, the game challenges you to survive in a new reality, uncover the secrets behind the surrounding chaos, and experience the protagonist’s memories and inner struggles. We Were Here Tomorrow Total Mayhem Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 17 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now We Were Here Tomorrow – October 20 On an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica. When you awaken, you find yourselves inside the mysterious Norček Industries facility with little recollection of what happened. Director Kathleen Bowe needs your help to continue the work of her missing research team before a global crisis unfolds.
